discrepancy_investigation.root_cause: Phase 1 reported candidate count from housing_clean.csv (post Stage 02 Data Cleaning), while Phase 2 reported count from house_buying_dec29th_2025.csv (Stage 00 Raw Dataset).

address_duplication.explanation: 235 listings captured 'Tân Phú, Hồ Chí Minh' and 230 listings captured 'Hoài Đức, Hà Nội' due to BeautifulSoup select_one('div.address') matching the first item of a site-wide navigation sidebar widget on batdongsan.vn.
